problem_text:
A logistics firm is assembling a shipment of specialized equipment to maximize total utility while adhering to a cargo weight restriction.  

The available equipment units are:  
* Unit A: weight 19kg, utility 193 credits  
* Unit B: weight 32kg, utility 271 credits  
* Unit C: weight 16kg, utility 231 credits  
* Unit D: weight 50kg, utility 86 credits  
* Unit E: weight 39kg, utility 105 credits  
* Unit F: weight 22kg, utility 102 credits  
* Unit G: weight 49kg, utility 21 credits  
* Unit H: weight 22kg, utility 86 credits  
* Unit I: weight 7kg, utility 272 credits  
* Unit J: weight 21kg, utility 136 credits  
* Unit K: weight 7kg, utility 297 credits  
* Unit L: weight 7kg, utility 254 credits  
* Unit M: weight 34kg, utility 262 credits  
* Unit N: weight 19kg, utility 181 credits  
* Unit O: weight 40kg, utility 56 credits  
* Unit P: weight 14kg, utility 31 credits  
* Unit Q: weight 41kg, utility 216 credits  
* Unit R: weight 17kg, utility 272 credits  
* Unit S: weight 46kg, utility 184 credits  
* Unit T: weight 15kg, utility 184 credits  
* Unit U: weight 17kg, utility 43 credits  
* Unit V: weight 29kg, utility 75 credits  

Furthermore, the selection must include exactly one of Unit A or Unit B.  

If Unit C is included, the effective cargo capacity is diminished by 10 kg.  
The transport vehicle can accommodate a maximum load of 394 kg. The firm must determine which units to include in the shipment.
